messages:
Zoe: Morning — short brief: we need A/B hero variants for Hosted API/Dedicated/Private, plus the launch-post pack and exact RSVP form slugs for routing. Can we finalise today?
Pri: Ill run Hosted A/Bs. Plan: Variant A (performance): "Hosted inference, production latency you can trust." Variant B (developer): "API-first LLMs that fit your stack." Each with 1-line proof and CTA.
Malik: Ill do Dedicated & Private. Dedicated A/B: SLA-first vs throughput-first. Private A/B: VPC/emphasis vs compliance/emphasis. Will keep bullets 3-5 words.
Jenna: Ill craft the launch posts (X, LinkedIn) + webinar landing blurb. Also drafting the gated 3-min teaser video copy. RSVP fields: prefer snake_case: deployment_choice, lead_purpose, company_size, contact_email.
Zoe: Routing priorities: demo -> sales (immediate slack ping); enterprise -> sales + ops tag; technical -> devx (batched daily); webinar -> growth automation. For private+enterprise, add priority_ops tag and CC infra.
Malik: Dedicated sample line: "Sample results: 180 QPS, p95 220ms on common configs (sample)." Will clearly label as sample. Private bullets: "VPC & on-prem", "KMS/HSM", "Audit logs".
Pri: Hosted proof lines: "p50 ~95ms (short Q&A, sample)" and "Includes SDKs + quickstart". CTA A: "Get started (free credits)" CTA B: "Request a demo".
Jenna: Social copy idea: X/Twitter single-line hook + RSVP link with utm_source=launch_x campaign=runfast_apr. LinkedIn longer post with 3 bullets + CTA. Webinar follow-up cadence: Day0 confirmation + 3-min teaser, Day2 recap + resources, Day6 Sales outreach (if qualified).
Zoe: Can ops wire these slugs exactly as `deployment_choice`, `lead_purpose`, `company_size`, `contact_email`? Also we want demo and enterprise to generate immediate slack pings to #sales-notifs.
infra-bot: Staging webhook created (job 2044) — awaiting sample payload test.
Malik: One more nuance: include micro-FAQ line on Dedicated page: "Can I pin model versions? Yes  controlled rollouts supported."
Pri: Hosted alt copy (cost-led): "Lower per-token cost with caching + batching" proof: "Intelligent batching reduces unit cost (sample)."
Jenna: Ill prepare three post variants and UTM table (twitter/linkedin/email), and include gated preview video for registrants.
Zoe: Action items:
- Pri: final Hosted A/B copy + CTAs (due 3pm)
- Malik: finalize Dedicated & Private bullets + benchmark snippet (due 3pm)
- Jenna: publish launch-post drafts + UTM table + RSVP copy (due 4pm)
- Infra: implement webhook routing + slack alerts for demo/enterprise and post sample payload (due 5pm)
infra-bot: Staging webhook test passed (job 2044) — payload example: {"company":"Acme","deployment_choice":"Hosted","lead_purpose":"demo"} :white_check_mark:
Zoe: Nice. Keep CTAs consistent: primary "Get started (free credits)"; secondary on Dedicated/Private "Request a demo". Please ping here when done and Ill collect assets into /marketing-assets and tag #design. React with :rocket: when your piece is complete.
